entries.title: Nehemiah 11:1
segments: And the rulers of the people lived at Jerusalem. And the rest of the people cast lots, to bring one of every ten to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in [other] cities.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:2
segments: And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to live at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:3
segments: And these [are] the rulers of the province who lived in Jerusalem. But in the cities of Judah everyone lived in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the temple-slaves, and the sons of Solomon's servants.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:4
segments: And at Jerusalem lived [certain] of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin. From the sons of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the sons of Perez,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:5
segments: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:6
segments: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem [were] four hundred and sixty-eight mighty men.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:7
segments: And these [are] the sons of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah;

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:8
segments: and after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:9
segments: And Joel the son of Zichri [was] their overseer. And Judah the son of Senuah [was] second over the city.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:10
segments: From the priests [were] Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:11
segments: Seraiah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:12
segments: And their brothers who did the work of the house [were] eight hundred and twenty-two. And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:13
segments: and his brothers, chief of the fathers, two hundred and forty-two. And Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:14
segments: and their brothers, mighty men of power, [were] a hundred and twenty-eight. And their overseer [was] Zabdiel, the son of [one of] the great men.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:15
segments: And from the Levites [were] Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:16
segments: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, [were over] the outward business of the house of God.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:17
segments: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, [was] the leader to begin the thanksgiving in prayer. And Bakbukiah was second among his brothers, and then Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:18
segments: All the Levites in the holy city [were] two hundred and eighty-four.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:19
segments: And the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers who kept the gates, [were] a hundred and seventy-two.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:20
segments: And the rest of Israel, of the priests [and] the Levites, [were] in all the cities of Judah, each one in his inheritance.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:21
segments: But the temple-slaves lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gispa [were] over the temple-slaves.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:22
segments: And the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem [was] Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers [were] over the business of the house of God.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:23
segments: For [it was] the king's commandment concerning them that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:24
segments: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the sons of Zerah the son of Judah, [was] at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:25
segments: And for the villages, with their fields, [some] of the sons of Judah lived at Kirjath-arba, and in its villages, and at Dibon, and in its villages, and at Jekabzeel, and its villages,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:26
segments: and at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:27
segments: and at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and [in] its villages,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:28
segments: and at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in its villages,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:29
segments: and at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:30
segments: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, at Lachish, and the fields of it, at Azekah, and [in] its villages. And they lived from Beer-sheba to the valley of Hinnom.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:31
segments: And the sons of Benjamin from Geba [lived] at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and their villages,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:32
segments: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:33
segments: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:34
segments: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:35
segments: Lod, and Ono, the Valley of Craftsmen.

entries.title: Nehemiah 11:36
segments: And divisions of the Levites [were] [in] Judah and for Benjamin.
